system.description:
• Effect: When you have no slot left of a spell's level, you may still cast it by burning points from your Strength, Dexterity or Constitution equal to the spell's level, split between them as you like.
  • The magic tears through you: after the spell is cast you take 1d6 damage per spell level.
  • Temporary HP absorbs it first, but Resistance and other reductions don't apply.
  • You may add a Metamagic option, paid for as usual.
  • 15th level: once per day, you Overchannel without taking its damage; you still burn the points.

activities.name: Overchannel

After the spell you take 1d6 damage per spell level; temporary HP absorb it first, but Resistance and other reductions don't apply. You may add a Metamagic option, paid for as usual.

activities.name: Overchannel (no damage)
activities.text: Once per day from 15th: Overchannel without taking its damage (you still burn the points).
